description:
Convert 2-10 documents to Markdown in one call (Pro API key required).

    Each item is either {"url": ..., "filename_hint"?: ...} or
    {"content_base64": ..., "filename": ...}; types may be mixed. Items are
    converted in parallel and isolated: one bad URL or file never fails the
    batch — its slot returns ok:false with the error. The combined markdown
    shares one output budget, split evenly across items (per-item `truncated`
    flags apply). Set include_markdown=false to get only metadata + quality
    per item (health-check a folder without flooding your context).

    Anonymous callers: use convert_url / convert_base64 individually.
name: convert_batch
